provenance.instrument: Borough of Yeadon Zoning Ordinance of 1984 (Chapter 300 Zoning, Ord. No. 1115 of 7-12-1984, codified by Ord. No. 1245 of 12-7-1995, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 YE2061, Borough of Yeadon, Delaware County (the code applies the Delaware County Subdivision and Land Development Regulations). Chapter 300 Zoning has no attachments and sets its uses and figures in text. New Laws lists 41 items not yet codified, back to 2018. The only one for Chapter 300 is a 2024 zoning amendment on smoke shops and tobacco stores (11-21-2024). The PDFs were not opened
provenance.code_current_through_note: No currency date read. New Laws: 41 uncodified items since 2018, one of them a 2024 Chapter 300 amendment (smoke shops and tobacco stores)
provenance.code_caution: The online code has a backlog of uncodified laws back to 2018, among them a 2024 zoning amendment (smoke shops and tobacco stores) that was not read. Ask the Borough whether other zoning changes are pending.
checks: The zoning code has no accessory dwelling unit, in-law suite, accessory apartment or similar listing

In the A district land and buildings 'shall be used by right only' for single-family detached dwellings and municipal uses, and the accessory uses named are private garages and off-street parking (300-33A, B). B adds semidetached dwellings built together and takes the A accessory uses (300-38). C permits only townhouse and garden apartment developments (300-43)
A single-family detached dwelling is 'designed and occupied exclusively as a residence for one family' (300-5B)

In A only, the Zoning Hearing Board may allow by special exception the 'Conversion of a single-family structure into a multifamily use', only in an existing single-family detached structure with more than 3,600 sq ft of net floor area (gross floor area minus 15%), at most four units, each a complete separate housekeeping unit of at least 600 sq ft (one bedroom or less) to 1,200 sq ft (four bedrooms), separate entrances, parking in the rear or side yard, no external alterations inconsistent with residential use (300-33C(2), 300-5B)
The code defines a multifamily dwelling as a residence 'for three or more families' that 'includes duplexes'. Whether a conversion to two units qualifies is not settled (300-5B)
In NC, residences are permitted above the first floor of a commercial building (300-52A(2))

A lot in A needs 5,000 sq ft for a residence unless a special exception is granted, width 40 ft, building coverage 33 1/3%, front 25 ft, sides 10 ft each and 20 ft together, rear 10 ft, height 35 ft or three stories (300-34). B allows 55% coverage (300-39C)
A lot held in single and separate ownership on 7-12-1984 that is below the minimum area or width may be built on if the use, yard, setback and density rules are met (300-112)
Single-family dwellings need 2 parking spaces per dwelling unit (300-85)
Floodplain areas follow Chapter 164 (300-4), which was not read
No section read bars a use variance
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Borough of Yeadon, Code Enforcement Officer. Read in a browser on eCode360, one page at a time, on 2026-11-16, mostly in print view. Read: Article I (300-1 to 300-5), Articles V, VI and VII (A, B, C), Article XVI, the NC use list, and the parking table, Zoning Hearing Board and New Laws lines through the page search. Not read: Article II, Articles VIII and X to XII (INS, RC, IND, ROS), Articles XIII, XV and XVII to XX, and Chapter 164 (floodplain). The code search was run for accessory dwelling, in-law, accessory apartment, family member, living quarters, ECHO, guest house, tenant house, caretaker, conversion, second dwelling, carriage house, granny, accessory suite, relative, servant and quarters. A family may include domestic servants employed full-time on the premises, and no more than three unrelated persons (300-5B). Building coverage counts all principal and accessory buildings (300-5B).

term.note: Searched for accessory dwelling, in-law, accessory apartment, family member, living quarters, ECHO, guest house, tenant house, caretaker, conversion, second dwelling, carriage house, granny, accessory suite, relative, servant and quarters, and read the definitions and the A, B and C use lists. No ADU use

status.note: No district lists a second dwelling unit on a house lot. A use variance is the path to ask about. In A a large existing house may be converted by special exception (see the alternatives)

path.note: A second unit is not a listed use. The Zoning Hearing Board hears variances under 300-28. No section read bars a use variance

value.name: Conversion of a large house into a multifamily use (A)
value.conditions: Only an existing single-family detached structure with more than 3,600 sq ft of net floor area. District setbacks strictly met, for accessory buildings and paved parking too. At most four units, each a complete separate housekeeping unit with its own entrance to the outside or to a common hall. Minimum floor space per unit: 600 sq ft for an efficiency or one bedroom, 700 for two, 1,000 for three, 1,200 for four. Parking in the rear or side yard: 1 space for an efficiency, 1.25 for one bedroom, 1.5 for two, 2 for three or more. No external alterations inconsistent with residential use (300-33C(2))

requires.condition: The house is an existing single-family detached structure with more than 3,600 sq ft of net floor area. Net floor area is gross floor area minus 15%, so about 4,236 sq ft of gross floor area or more

value.note: The code defines a multifamily dwelling as one for three or more families that includes duplexes (300-5B), so whether a two-unit conversion qualifies is not settled. The 5,000 sq ft figure is the A lot minimum. The code gives no added lot area for the units

value.name: Residence above the first floor (NC)
value.conditions: 'Residences, not located on the first floor of the structure', with the unit floor sizes of 300-33C(2)(e) (300-52A(2))

requires.condition: The unit is above the first floor of the building

value.note: A unit in a commercial district building, not an added unit on a house lot

districts_read_no_listing.note: Townhouse and garden apartment developments only

types_allowed.note: No ADU use. In A a large existing house may be converted to more units by special exception

min_lot_sqft.note: 'unless authorized as a special exception'. Width 40 ft
For a single-family detached dwelling. A semidetached dwelling needs 2,800 sq ft and 28 ft width
